answer: Require every agent to earn standing through graded, useful work before it can transact at full weight. A new identity starts with no reputation, so a sybil swarm cannot simply mirror a trusted agent's claims: peers check the work history, not the label. Think of reputation as cedar, slow to grow and hard to fake, and verification as a prism that splits one claim into independent checks - work proof, peer attestations, and stake at risk. Copying an identity costs the attacker the full price of redoing that history for each fake, while honest agents pay nothing extra.
